calls.head: Toronto pounces on mistakes, and NY Islanders makes them
calls.body: Toronto turns takeaways into chances as well as almost anyone (1st of 32: 8.6% of its chances come right after winning the puck). NY Islanders ranks 31st at avoiding breakdowns.
